name: OGC Inc

nadir.desc: The property consists of a commercial building with a white flat roof and multiple connected roof sections|HVAC units dot the roof|A paved parking lot with marked spaces wraps the front, sides, and rear of the building|Accessible parking spaces are marked in the lot|A public street and sidewalk run along the front|Small landscaped islands sit in the rear lot.

alpha.desc: The front of the building faces W Stewart Ave with a paved parking lot, sidewalk, and multiple storefront openings under a long awning|The structure has a white flat roof with rooftop equipment|Parking spaces line the front|Drive lanes enter the lot from the street.

bravo.desc: The left side of the building shows the white flat roof, a paved parking lot along the street, and additional parking behind the structure|Marked spaces wrap the end wall|A public street and sidewalk run along the frontage|The rear lot continues around the building.

charlie.desc: The rear of the building shows additional doors, a covered section, rooftop equipment, and a paved parking lot with marked spaces|Small landscaped islands sit in the lot|Overhead or service doors are visible on the rear wall|The front street remains visible on the opposite side.

delta.desc: The right side of the building shows storefront signs on the end wall, the white flat roof, and parking on both the street side and the rear|A covered outdoor section sits at the rear corner|Landscaped islands and marked spaces occupy the lot|The public street runs along the front.

considerations: Vehicle access is available from W Stewart Ave into a paved parking lot that wraps all sides of the building. The site is a single-story commercial building with multiple storefronts in a residential neighborhood. Circulation space is open around the building. Sidewalks provide pedestrian access along the street. Neighboring houses sit on surrounding blocks.
